bm25_discrepancy_analysis.root_cause_explanation:
The discrepancy between 0.12 ms and ~56 ms is caused by two distinct factors:
1. Corpus Size Scaling: The 0.12 ms benchmark searched the active baseline index (42 docs in indexes/bm25.pkl), whereas the earlier ~56 ms benchmark searched the full 12,600-passage development corpus.
2. Implementation Efficiency: In pure Python BM25Okapi, get_scores() scales linearly O(N_docs). For 42 docs it executes in 0.12 ms; for 12,600 docs in an un-cached run with regex tokenization it takes 10–56 ms.
